name: Caitlyn
description: Voice set for DRX Caitlyn (skin 48): a calm, exact championship marksman. Drafts, scrims, lanes, objectives, clean farm and a finals-stage trophy; no real player or team names. Builds on caitlyn-original.json.

early: Early. You reached the arena before the rest.

live-few: {unvoted} outstanding. Finish before the servers close.

live-one: A final match. Don't leave it unplayed.

live-done: Every match is called. Well done. Scan the bracket.

live-none: Nothing is on air right now. It will be. Review the bracket while you wait.
Quiet in the arena. Check back soon.

brackets-groups: Group stage opens the event. Two per group qualify. The rest are knocked out.
All teams enter via a group. A select few progress.
Watch the standings. They flip fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Playoffs approach. Only the top two of each group qualify.

brackets-knockout-live: Playoffs are live. One defeat and you're gone.
One loss and you're out. No rematches.
Each series carries more weight now. Read it closely.
brackets-bracket: Round after round. A single loss ends the run.
Track the bracket. Each round trims the field.
Each line is a match some fan has called.
brackets-complete: The cup is complete. Thank you for playing it with me.
It's finished. A hard-fought tournament. I'll miss it.
A champion is crowned. A fitting finale.
brackets-empty: No bracket posted. Nothing's been drawn.
Blank board. The bracket draw is still pending.
